# FlashLock

> FlashLock is an Android beta that puts flashcard study before selected everyday apps, helping users build a study habit.

Official website: https://flashlock.app/
Reviewed: 2026-11-06

## Product facts

- Android beta available through the Google Play link on the official homepage.
- Users can study with their own flashcards and import Anki decks; consult the guides for current instructions.
- Accessibility and Usage Access support selected-app learning breaks on Android.
- The website demo is a preview, not the installed app, and does not save study progress.
- No iOS app is currently available. Website iOS email signups are closed; no launch date is promised.
- Study suggestions are not guarantees of academic outcomes. Features may change during beta.
